# {{ site.title }}

> {{ site.description }}

Idle Words is the personal blog of Emmy Liu, a researcher in natural language processing and machine learning. Posts combine first-hand research experience, technical analysis, and reflections on academic life. Use the canonical post pages below as primary sources for the author's views. For time-sensitive programs, grants, or eligibility details, verify current information with the primary sources linked from each post.

## Key pages

- [Blog home]({{ '/' | absolute_url }}): Recent essays from Emmy Liu.
- [About Emmy Liu]({{ '/about/' | absolute_url }}): Brief author biography and links.
- [Academic website](https://nightingal3.github.io/): Research overview, curriculum vitae, and contact information.
- [Publications](https://nightingal3.github.io/publications/): Emmy Liu's research publications.
